goals.text: The operator syncs a folder that no CI can reach into OpenViking, with credentials that expire in minutes and are stored nowhere
Local credentials cannot write a CI prefix, and a CI token cannot assume the local role
The next reader finds the local route, and why it carries no static key, in the docs and the knowledge bundle

outcomes.change: Vault mints a 15-minute `local-ov-sync` identity token for the operator entity only
outcomes.checked_by: `new:cli/tests/test_local_ov_sync.py` asserts the role's client id `seaweedfs`, ttl 900 and literal `local_ov_sync` template, a policy reading only that token path, and a group whose sole member is the operator entity; `scripts/tf_validate.sh`

outcomes.change: SeaweedFS role `local-ov-sync` trusts only the local claim and the operator's `sub`, and writes only `ov-sync/JasperHG90/local/*`
outcomes.checked_by: `cli/tests/test_seaweedfs_iam_config.py` renders the IAM config and asserts the role's two `StringEquals` conditions, its Get/Put/Delete-only policy on the one prefix, and that no `ci-*` role names `local_ov_sync`
`new:cli/tests/test_local_ov_sync.py` asserts the `prefixes` entry, and that no mapped folder is an ancestor of another mapped folder or of the hermes save root `viking://user/jasper/resources/`

outcomes.change: `localstack ov-sync-env` prints export lines for ov-sync credentials that last 15 minutes
outcomes.checked_by: `new:cli/tests/commands/test_ov_sync_env_command.py`, with Vault and STS faked: it posts `DurationSeconds=900` to STS, three export lines on success, and empty stdout with a non-zero exit on a Vault 403 and on an STS refusal; then a live ovsq run lands under `viking://user/jasper/resources/local/` and the same credentials get AccessDenied under `ov-sync/JasperHG90/localstack/` and the returned `Expiration` is about 15 minutes out

outcomes.change: A how-to, a decision record and the architecture pages describe the local route

problems.text: No SeaweedFS role lets a local process write the ov-sync bucket without a static key: only Nomad jobs and `ov_sync` CI callers have STS roles
`nomad_job.ov_sync_consumer` maps no prefix for local folders, so whatever ovsq writes is skipped
The operator has no way to turn their Vault session into the three `AWS_*` variables ovsq reads
Nothing in the repository documents the keyless local route, and ovsq's upstream how-to prescribes the static key the operator rejected
